facts.fact: Moov Africa Gabon Telecom's Moov Money mobile money service is in service, with customers paying taxes through it from 10 July 2025, per Gabonreview.
The DGI with Moov Africa Gabon Telecom launched e-Tax on 10 July 2025, letting taxpayers under 30m FCFA turnover pay taxes via Moov Money, first in Akanda, Owendo and Port-Gentil.
The DGI's e-Tax service lets small taxpayers declare and pay by phone, in 2 or 3 minutes according to its deputy project director, launched 10 July 2025.
Moov Money customers can pay taxes in part or in full through e-Tax and retrieve the receipt on the tax site, per Moov Money's director general.
